import_legacy_remove_old.title: Move {name} to the new integration
import_legacy_remove_old.description:
{name} is still running on the old Oppo UDP-20x integration (oppo_udp), which no longer gets updates. To move it, keeping its entities, names, areas and history:

1. Delete the `custom_components/oppo_udp` folder.
2. Restart Home Assistant.
3. Go to **Add Integration**, search for **Oppo**, and choose **Import**.

After the restart Home Assistant reports "Integration oppo_udp not found". Don't choose **Remove previous configurations** there: it deletes the player's settings before they can be imported.

abort.legacy_still_installed: The old Oppo UDP-20x integration (oppo_udp) is still installed. Delete the custom_components/oppo_udp folder, restart Home Assistant, then try again. Your player's settings and history are kept until then.
abort.no_legacy_entries: There are no players left to import from the old Oppo UDP-20x integration.
